The fork carries the assumed-compatible-list fix (record 2026-09-10, draft 37 "Fork status") and draft 38's PEmemberof compatibility consult, and answers `Defined {value: "Specified(7)", stdout: "", stderr: "", blocked: "false"}` rc 0 — the value ISO C11 §6.2.7#1 gives and gcc exits with (7). Class shared-model-fix: the ONLY pristine-side incomplete this register admits; the row retires (the case moves into tests/multi_tu/) when upstream fixes drafts 37/38. LADDER Tier A row 6b pins fork OCaml == Lean on the same input.
